Build a Scale-Up pipeline configuration

Source: R/config.R
config_scaleup.Rd

Constructs and validates the configuration shared by every pipeline stage, passed to every function of the package.

Usage

config_scaleup(
  country,
  input_dir,
  output_dir,
  nace_revision,
  nace_rev21_from = NULL,
  dominance = FALSE,
  dom_vars = c("employment", "turnover"),
  dom_num = 2,
  financials_unit = NULL,
  trade_value_unit = NULL
)

Arguments

country

2-letter ISO country code (e.g. "FR"). Drives output file naming and several country-specific data patches inside build_accounts_indicators() (see country_patches).

input_dir

Folder holding base_financials_<country>.dta (and plants_RAW_<country>.dta if available), exchange_rates.dta, and tl3_typology.dta. Must already exist.

output_dir

Folder the final CSV outputs and logs are written to. Must already exist.

nace_revision

Required. The NACE revision of the sector codes (sector_1d, sector_2d, sector_3d) in base_financials: "2" (NACE Rev. 2) or "2.1" (NACE Rev. 2.1, used for statistics from reference year 2025). The pipeline's sector rules are written for Rev. 2; Rev. 2.1 codes are converted to Rev. 2 first. The build stops if the codes do not match the declared revision (a section letter that does not belong to its division, division 45 in Rev. 2.1, section V in Rev. 2).

nace_rev21_from

For a panel coded in Rev. 2 up to some year and in Rev. 2.1 after: the first year in Rev. 2.1 (with nace_revision = "2"). NULL (the default): one revision for every year.

dominance

Logical; if TRUE, every output table gains dom_<var> disclosure-control columns for each variable in dom_vars. Default FALSE.

dom_vars

Character vector of variables the dominance ratio is computed on (only used if dominance = TRUE). Default c("employment", "turnover").

dom_num

Number of top units defining the dominance ratio (e.g. 2 means "share held by the 2 largest firms"). Default 2.

financials_unit

The unit of the money variables in base_financials: "EUR thousand" (as the variable dictionary asks) or "EUR" (divided by 1000 on input). NULL (the default) follows the original package: EUR for the countries in country_patches$rescale_to_thousands, EUR thousand otherwise. The build stops when turnover per employee does not fit EUR thousand after this step.

trade_value_unit

Trade package only: the unit of trade_value in trade_RAW_<country>.dta, "EUR" (divided by 1000) or "EUR thousand". NULL (the default) follows the trade package: EUR for PT and HU, EUR thousand otherwise (country_patches$trade_values_in_eur).

Value

An object of class scaleup_config.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
cfg <- config_scaleup(
  country = "FR",
  input_dir = "V:/SCALE_UP/DTA/",
  output_dir = "V:/SCALE_UP/TMP/",
  nace_revision = "2",
  dominance = FALSE
)
} # }
